MATCH (t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City)
WHERE CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) <= 1978
   OR t.team_name = 'Dallas Mavericks'
   OR CAST(t.championships AS INT64) > 3
   OR c.city_name = 'Atlanta'
RETURN t.championships AS col1, t.founded_year AS col2, c.city_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
